title: Empty and Universal Relations
subject: Mathematics
objective: In a boys' school, who is whose sister? Nobody, and Maths has a name for that. What a relation is, and its two extreme cases.

fill.q: A relation in A is a subset of A × ____.
A relation with no pairs is an ____ relation.
If R = A × A, the relation is ____.
Empty and universal relations are called ____ relations.
If A has 3 elements, A × A has ____ pairs.

tf.q: The empty set is a relation in A.
tf.explain: It is a subset of A × A.

tf.q: A universal relation contains every ordered pair.
Every relation is empty or universal.
In a boys' school, "a is the sister of b" is universal.

ar.a: The relation "a is a sister of b" on a boys' school is empty.
Any relation in A contains at most n² pairs.
ar.r: A × A has n² ordered pairs.

num.q: A has 5 elements. How many pairs does A × A have?
A has 3 elements. How many relations in A exist?
steps: Subsets of a set of 9 pairs: 2⁹

short.q: Define the empty and universal relations.
short.solution: Empty: no element is related to any element, R is the empty set. Universal: each element is related to every element, R = A × A.
